name: Baidu, Inc.
blurb: Baidu, Inc. is China's dominant internet search and AI technology company, operating a full-stack AI ecosystem that spans online search advertising, cloud infrastructure, and autonomous driving. Its core business generates the majority of revenue through search and marketing services, while its video-streaming subsidiary iQiyi contributes additional scale. Baidu has expanded aggressively into AI Cloud services and autonomous vehicle technology through its Apollo Go robotaxi platform, positioning itself as a leading AI infrastructure player in China with a market capitalization exceeding $53 billion.
recent: BIDU shares surged more than 20% in recent weeks following the announcement of a spin-off of its Kunlunxin AI chip unit and continued expansion of Apollo Go robotaxi services into Abu Dhabi and Dubai. Analysts have issued upgrades — including from Freedom Capital and BOC International — maintaining a Strong Buy consensus with average price targets around $165, citing robust growth in AI Cloud and non-marketing revenues even as core search advertising faces headwinds from macroeconomic pressures in China. The Kunlunxin spin-off has been the primary near-term catalyst, with investors increasingly pricing in long-term value from Baidu's autonomous driving and AI infrastructure ambitions.
